title: The 4 Best String Trimmers for Steep Hills and Slopes
h1: The 4 Best String Trimmers for Steep Hills and Slopes
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for string trimmers for steep hills and slopes, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at string trimmers for steep hills and slopes using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: EGO Power+ ST1521S 15-Inch String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-inch cutting swath, Carbon fiber split shaft, adjustable length, 56V ARC Lithium battery, 2.5Ah included.
strengths: Carbon fiber shaft keeps weight low without sacrificing reach on an incline
Adjustable shaft length helps you stand on flatter ground and reach up a slope
56V torque holds cutting speed even when working at an awkward uphill angle
limitations: Still needs two hands for full control, no single-handed operation on the steepest grades
56V battery adds cost over more basic 40V options
No specific anti-slip grip texture beyond the standard handle
features: Carbon fiber split shaft, adjustable length

products.name: Husqvarna 128LD Gas String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 28cc 2-cycle gas engine, 17-inch cutting swath, Straight shaft.
strengths: No battery to run down partway through a large sloped lot
17-inch swath covers more ground per pass on long hillside runs
Straight shaft gives good reach on a graded slope
limitations: Heavier than any cordless option here, a real factor on unstable footing
Vibration and engine weight add fatigue over a long uphill session
No adjustable shaft length to change reach on the fly

products.name: Worx WG183 40V String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 13-inch dual-exit cutting head, 40V PowerShare, 2 x 2.0Ah batteries included, Under 5 pounds.
strengths: Lightest trimmer in this list, easiest to hold steady on a steep, short section
Two batteries mean you're not stuck mid-slope with a dead pack
Low weight reduces arm fatigue holding the tool at an uphill angle
limitations: 13-inch swath means more back-and-forth passes on a wide slope
Fixed shaft length, less reach flexibility than the EGO's adjustable design
Less motor torque for thick growth that often collects on untended slopes

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12-Inch Cordless String Trimmer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch cutting swath, 40V lithium battery, 2.0Ah included, Dual line auto-feed.
strengths: Light enough to handle on a moderate incline without excess fatigue
Lowest price of the group for occasional slope maintenance
Variable speed trigger helps conserve the smaller battery on shorter slope sessions
limitations: 2.0Ah battery has the shortest runtime, a real constraint on a long slope
12-inch swath is the narrowest here for covering hillside ground
Less motor torque than the EGO for thick growth on an untended slope

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
